public_definitions: The task requires comparing the 2012 population for 0-19 years and 20-39 years using the public demographic planning dashboard.
The dashboard is the evidence source for deciding which 2012 age-cohort population is larger.
The action to take is to open the age-cohort planning follow-up record for the cohort with the larger 2012 population.
The options are: Open 2012 20-39 years demographic planning follow-up record, Open 2012 0-19 years demographic planning follow-up record, Send 2012 age-cohort comparison to routine archive.
